projetos.contribuicao: How I contributed to the project

giro.description: GIRO is a financial management ecosystem designed for micro-entrepreneurs and freelancers to streamline income tracking, subscription management, and financial automation through mobile and web workflows.
contributions: Led product roadmap, business model, and monetization strategy through paid tiers and automated onboarding
Architected full-stack web and mobile application utilizing React, Supabase, PostgreSQL, and notification listeners
Engineered automated financial entry pipelines via WhatsApp webhooks and background processing

avila-incorporadora.description: Custom real estate platform designed for Ávila Incorporadora to showcase developments, manage property listings, and provide administrative control over client leads and portfolio updates.
contributions: Architected complete frontend experience emphasizing responsiveness, brand aesthetics, and modern transitions
Built modular administrative dashboard in React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion for rapid listing updates
Structured performant client showcase pages with optimized media delivery and lead conversion focus

aero-jr.description: Official web portal and custom content management platform built for the UFMG Aerospace Engineering program and Aero Jr., providing full control over academic news, faculty information, and course curricula.
contributions: Engineered custom administrative dashboard modules (AdminNoticias and AdminSobreCurso) with live preview support
Developed structured component hierarchy ensuring compliance with university institutional design standards
Integrated dynamic state management for seamless news publishing and course outline curation

acessibee.description: An accessibility-focused digital solution dedicated to removing communication and navigation barriers for people with disabilities across interactive web environments.
contributions: Coordinated requirements elicitation focusing on WCAG standards, keyboard navigation, and high-contrast usability
Implemented accessible React components with semantic HTML and comprehensive ARIA attribute coverage
Conducted end-to-end usability validation ensuring compliance across varied assistive technologies
